title: introduce-proofstore-rbac-fingerprint-ttl-and-kms-consent-adapter
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: tighten operator-scoped credentials and make operator actions auditable and region-aware. This PR introduces a small, opt-in ProofStore service plus a lightweight RBAC v2 fingerprint TTL for operator grants, and a KMS Consent Adapter that enforces data-residency (region pin) and per-request consent for customer-managed keys. The goal is to reduce risk from long-lived operator bindings, provide a verifiable proof trail for high-privilege operations, and ensure KMS usage respects tenant residency configuration.

Summary of changes: added a new internal service (proofstore) that records signed operator proofs and exposes a read-only verifier API; extended the RBAC engine with a fingerprint TTL feature and a compact policy annotation to mark timebound operator roles; implemented kms/consent adapter middleware that plugs into the KMS client factory and verifies per-request region claims (with configurable allow/deny lists); added audit-intent header validation in api-gateway to surface operator intent in audit logs; migration to add operator_proofs table and a small indexing shim for audit queries.

Key components (high level):
- proofstore service: internal/http service under services/proofstore; stores signed proofs as protobuf messages (signed by operator private key stored in operator-credential-manager). Exposes /v1/verify and /v1/query endpoints (read-only for runtime, write access only by operator-credential-manager during proof issuance). Proofs are sharded by tenant_id and indexed by operation_id and timestamp.
- rbac engine changes: introduced fingerprint_ttl config (default 0 = unlimited) and a new annotation rbac.timebound=true + rbac.ttl_seconds=<n>. Engine will automatically expire cached role assertions and surface an audit_event when a timebound role is used after TTL.
- kms consent adapter: middleware that inspects request metadata (tenant_claims.region, kms_key.location_hint) and enforces the tenant residency policy; if mismatch it either rejects the request or routes to a configured consent flow (telemetry emitted). Supports multi-provider KMS where provider location precedence is configured per-tenant.
- audit improvements: api-gateway now requires X-Audit-Intent header for operator-scoped endpoints and records consent_flow outcomes. Audit pipeline enriched with proof_id references when operations are validated via proofstore.

Migration and rollout notes: DB migration adds operator_proofs (id, tenant_id, operation_id, proof_blob, signer_id, created_at, audited boolean). We add an index on (tenant_id, operation_id). Rollout plan is staged: start proofstore in read-only verification mode (no writes) and enable kms consent adapter with warn-only mode for 2 weeks (warning events go to audit and metrics only). After validation, enable enforcement and then enable proof issuance for new operator grants. Backwards compatibility: fingerprint_ttl default remains unlimited so existing tenants unchanged until opted in.

Testing: unit tests for RBAC TTL and KMS adapter logic; integration tests for proofstore verification flow; e2e validation in private-installer test harness using a short-lived operator grant to validate expiry. Added load-test smoke to ensure proofstore verification latency < 8ms P90 under 200 RPS.

Security review & mitigations: proofs are stored encrypted-at-rest using tenant CMK; access requires operator-credential-manager credential; proofstore server enforces mTLS and is behind internal network ACL. We added rate limits and a small retention policy for proofs to reduce blast radius. CI includes a security-lint job to detect accidental key logging.

Related work: ties into ENG-1938 (operator-grant-cleanup) and SEC-421 (kms-region-consent-policy).

Merge outcome: squash and merge after required approvals and green CI.

Rollback: disable kms consent adapter by flipping feature flag and revert mTLS route; a DB cleanup job can mark recent proofs as non-audited for emergency rollback scenarios.

release_notes: Adds an opt-in ProofStore to record operator proofs, RBAC fingerprint TTL for timebound operator grants, and a KMS Consent Adapter to enforce tenant region pinning. Rollout is opt-in and documented; default behavior unchanged.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flags gradually: feature.proofstore.enabled (read-only) -> feature.kms.consent_warn_only -> feature.kms.consent_enforce -> feature.proofstore.issuance. Monitor proofstore.verif_latency_p90 and audit.intent_missing_count.
backport_guidance: This is a platform-level feature; backports only to v2026-02 branch for critical customers. Backport requires DB migration and chart updates; coordinate with infra and private-installer teams.
